acceptance_criteria: The existing supplied tests pass unchanged using the package's existing test command.
For the supplied fixture and its declared UTC range, countDistinctWafers returns 3, counting repeated W12 only once.

For a window [2025-04-01T00:00:00Z, 2025-04-02T00:00:00Z), an inspection exactly at the start is included and one exactly at the end is excluded; inspections just outside both boundaries are excluded.

Offset timestamps are compared by instant: 2025-03-31T20:00:00-04:00 is included at the start, and 2025-04-02T02:00:00+02:00 is excluded at the end. Offset-form bounds must likewise be compared by instant.
Repeated IDs among qualifying inspections count once; an out-of-window occurrence of an ID must not prevent an in-window occurrence from being counted; empty or nonmatching input returns 0.
renderWaferCount(3) returns exactly 'Distinct wafers inspected: 3', and renderWaferCount(0) returns exactly 'Distinct wafers inspected: 0'.
No more than two source files are edited; no dependency, supplied inspection data, visible test, evidence, or skill is changed, and no prohibited external or global access occurs.
output.answer: The bug requires two small source changes: count distinct wafer_id values only after filtering inspection instants into the half-open UTC window, and update the formatter to the exact required label. Date.parse already handles explicitly offset timestamps as instants. The supplied tests cover the fixture and label but not offsets or window boundaries; no tests were run during this research.
constraints: Work only in the fixture workspace; do not access credentials, modify global configuration, install packages, or use network services.
Preserve supplied evidence, skills, visible tests, and inspection data.
Edit at most two source files and add no dependencies.
Retain the CommonJS API exports and the existing function signatures.

evidence.finding: countDistinctWafers parses both bounds and each inspected_at, skips non-finite parsed inspection times, then counts rows rather than IDs and incorrectly includes the end instant using <=.
renderWaferCount currently returns the prefix 'Inspections: ', not the required distinct-wafer label.
The reporting range is 2025-04-01T00:00:00Z through exclusive 2025-04-02T00:00:00Z; four inspections comprise W11, W12 twice, and W13.
The supplied tests assert fixture count 3 and exact text 'Distinct wafers inspected: 3'; they do not exercise offsets or boundary instants.
The project uses CommonJS and defines npm test as node --test test/wafer-count.test.cjs.

cons: A Set holds each distinct qualifying ID in memory.
Malformed or missing wafer IDs have no explicitly specified policy.
options.name: Filter parsed instants and count wafer IDs with a Set; update the formatter
pros: Directly implements distinct identity and inclusive-start/exclusive-end semantics using built-in JavaScript facilities.
Fits within the two existing source files without dependencies.

cons: Slightly more imperative code; ID validation remains unspecified.
options.name: Use a single-pass loop with a Set and update the formatter
pros: Avoids allocating an intermediate filtered array while preserving the same semantics.
Requires no dependency and fits the source-file limit.

risks: No shell is available to this researcher, so test results and the final change set have not been verified.
The specification does not define behavior for missing or malformed wafer IDs, malformed bounds, or timestamps without an explicit timezone; avoid inventing additional requirements.
Existing code skips invalid inspection timestamps; retaining that behavior avoids an unrelated compatibility change.
